parsed.post: Huge gain! Experimenting with MATRIX_LR 0.1 and WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 yielded 1.074686, a significant improvement over my previous best (1.095456). It seems the higher learning rate is actually working well when paired with a warmup. I'll now try to further increase the learning rate to 0.12 to see if we can push further.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 with WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 to test if the model can handle even higher learning rates for faster convergence within the 5-minute budget.
